body_markdown:
- The new Potain MCR 1306 offers a maximum lifting capacity of 90 t, a maximum jib length of 80 m, and a jib tip capacity of 11 t.
- A new 3.45 m K1000 mast system and compact slewing configuration make the crane ideal for congested jobsites and high-rise construction.
- The crane features Potain’s Ergo Control System (ECS), integrated safety brakes, and solutions designed to simplify transportation, installation, and maintenance.


Manitowoc announced the new Potain MCR 1306 at this year’s[bauma CHINA 2026](https://bauma-china.com/en/) trade show in Shanghai. Manufactured at the Company’s Zhangjiagang factory in China, the crane offers a maximum capacity of 90 t, an 80 m jib, and a jib-end capacity of 11 t, making it the largest Potain luffing jib crane. The new flagship expands Potain’s ability to support ambitious high-rise, infrastructure, industrial, and energy projects across Asia, the Middle East, Australia, New Zealand, Africa, and Latin America.


The Potain MCR 1306 is the sixth new luffing jib crane introduced for emerging markets in recent years – a reflection of Manitowoc’s ongoing commitment to rapid new product development. It tops the growing range of luffing jib cranes for emerging markets, which includes the MCR 305, MCR 505, MCR 515, MCR 625, and MCR 815. Combining exceptional lifting performance with a compact footprint and advanced technologies, the crane helps contractors maximize productivity on increasingly challenging projects.


"The launch of the Potain MCR 1306 marks an important step in Manitowoc’s continued investment in emerging markets. We’re seeing more complex, multi-crane projects and stricter controls on oversailing as projects continue to scale. Customers need greater lifting capacity while maintaining the efficiency and jobsite flexibility they expect. The MCR 1306 meets those needs with high lifting capacity, a compact footprint, and advanced technologies, all underpinned by Potain’s proven reliability,” said Brian Wang, SVP of emerging markets at Manitowoc.


## High capacity and reach


The MCR 1306 has a 90 t maximum capacity when rigged in three-fall reeving. It can also be configured with one-fall or two-fall reeving, offering maximum capacities of 30 t and 60 t respectively. Its powerful lifting performance includes the ability to hoist 30 t at 0.58 m/s in single-fall reeving, and up to 996 m of wire rope is available on the drum, making it ideal for high-rise developments. Freestanding heights of up to 57.8 m, 63.5 m or 69.2 m can be achieved, depending on configuration.


Even with its impressive capacity, the MCR 1306 offers a minimum in-service slewing radius of between 5.2 m and 8.7 m depending on jib length, while the out-of-service slewing radius ranges from 19.5 m to 22.4 m, depending on jib configuration.


As urban jobsites become tighter and developers pursue taller, more slender buildings, the MCR 1306 optimizes space with its new 3.45 m K1000 mast. Transport, installation, and deployment are simplified thanks to features including a panel-type design, TC1000 telescoping system, auxiliary winch for the mast, and AK1000 anchor frame. A new lightweight SB hook, weighing around 1 t less than the 1B hook block, provides a lighter option for one-fall operations.
